CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was present (A absent).

COD.rationale: C and D are explicit for several referents but O is present mainly as general layout/organization statements and not definitively bound to the same single referent/attribute/time required for an explicit COD binding; binding therefore ambiguous.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation or processing condition to a specific content's presentation/access; only candidate/current data and peaks are listed.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies contents (color labels) and their coordinate-valued attributes for current and candidate records.

D.rationale: The report separates identified content attributes (e.g. red coordinates) from distinct origin/status metadata entries for the same referents.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text describes how items are laid out (grid orientation) and reports candidate/current peak records and grouped coordinate patterns, indicating presentation/organization.
